thread.title: Iconic Video Game Rivalries That Defined Generations of Gaming
thread.title_full: Iconic Video Game Rivalries That Defined Generations of Gaming

author: Collider
title: Iconic Video Game Rivalries That Defined Generations of Gaming
text:
From Ace Attorney to Yakuza, explore the most iconic video game rivalries that have shaped storytelling and gameplay across generations of gaming.
Video game rivalries have become a defining element of the medium, creating memorable conflicts that span generations. From the courtroom battles of Phoenix Wright and Miles Edgeworth to the sibling rivalry of Dante and Vergil, these classic rivalries have left an indelible mark on gaming history. Their longevity and evolution across multiple titles demonstrate why gaming is uniquely suited to portray such enduring conflicts.
The Enduring Appeal of Video Game Rivalries
A classic rivalry between two distinct, memorable characters has been a staple of narrative storytelling long before the advent of video games. Yet something about the medium of gaming has made it perfect for the concept and longevity of many memorable rivalries. From an iconic hero constantly going toe-to-toe with an equally iconic villain to the rivalries that eventually form a sense of camaraderie and respect, actively playing as one or both of the characters in these rivalries makes them that much more impactful and memorable.
It further helps that these rivalries do not just stand out for one amazing game, but have evolved and grown across generations of gaming in some of the biggest franchises in gaming history. Gaming as an art form simply would not be the same without these rivalries, whether they be fan favorites of hardcore gamers or instantly recognizable to even those not as familiar with video games. Even as new games and effective rivalries are released, it is difficult to imagine any of them coming close to the strength of these iconic rivalries.
Phoenix Wright and Miles Edgeworth in Ace Attorney
For a game series all about defending clients in the court of law, it only makes sense that there would be a consistent rivalry between Ace Attorney series protagonist Phoenix Wright and the leading prosecutor, Miles Edgeworth. However, their actions and battles in court only scratch the surface of the dynamic between these two, as they have grown up as childhood friends and see their rivalry as a way to further drive and invigorate their work.
Their rivalry and friendship grow especially deeper as the games go on, bringing out the best in one another both in terms of their work and character. This rivalry and duo work so effectively thanks to how initially stark their personalities seem to be, with Phoenix being always joyous and optimistic about his clients' innocence, while Edgeworth is more jaded and quick to see the ruthlessness of the world around him. It makes for a lot of great banter between the two throughout the series, as even when Phoenix goes up against other prosecutors, none have left quite the impact that Edgeworth has.
Dante and Vergil in Devil May Cry
The bonds of blood and brotherhood are a quick and easy way to make for a powerful and emotionally striking rivalry, with one of the very best being the half-human, half-demon twin brothers of Dante and Vergil from Devil May Cry. While Vergil did not have a major appearance in the series until the prequel game Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening, his rivalry and parallels with Dante quickly made him a fan-favorite character in the franchise.
This was further amplified when the character made a prominent return in Devil May Cry 5, where he and Dante continued their rivalry and even decided to team up in the game's ending. The massive similarities prove to make their divides and differences that much more polarizing, with Dante embracing his human side and fighting demons while Vergil has embraced his demonic side to follow in his father's footsteps. Like many of the best attributes of the series, their rivalry thrives on the rule of cool, where giant swords and spectacle make their battles that much more impactful. Their rivalry even continues outside the series, with both of them being playable characters in fighting video games like Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3.
Solid Snake and Liquid Snake in Metal Gear
Snake has faced off against many powerful villains throughout the Metal Gear series, yet the deeper connections and lasting impact of his rivalry with Liquid Snake in Metal Gear Solid are easily a step above the rest. Acting as the primary antagonist of Metal Gear Solid, Liquid stands at the forefront of some of the game's most iconic moments, including his reveal as the true identity of Master Miller and their shirtless battle on top of the wreckage of Metal Gear Rex.
What really makes Liquid the premier rival for Solid Snake is how they both share origins as soldiers created by cloning the legendary Big Boss. Even after Liquid dies at the end of the first Metal Gear Solid, his influence stretches throughout the rest of the games, including his arm being transplanted to Liquid Ocelot in Metal Gear Solid 2, his consciousness taking over Ocelot's body in Metal Gear Solid 4, and even appearing as a 12-year-old child in the prequel Metal Gear Solid V.
Kazuma Kiryu and Goro Majima in Yakuza
The rivalry between Kazuma Kiryu and Goro Majima from the Yakuza series is one that initially began with the classic carnage and ruthlessness of underground crime, yet both sides of this rivalry grew to respect and honor one another as the series goes on. This evolution from adversaries to respected rivals exemplifies how video game rivalries can mature and deepen over time, adding layers to both characters and the narrative.
